holder-quote: Toren leapt forwards. He brought his buckler down.
effect-quote: Toren heard a satisfying crunch, and one of the arms snaring Insill fell away, broken.

holder-quote: His stone cracked the skeleton’s head, and Toren dug his fingers into the crack as he landed on the behemoth’s neck
